construction.comparison: On one initial probability space Xi_j->Xi in product-metric probability,with the whole initial family independent of W; F_j(Xi_j,W)->F(Xi,W) in fixed-horizon product-path probability
construction.tightness: Uniform bounded-link drifts and Ito/BDG fourth increments combine with summable quaternion metric weights; Wiener space is a countable product,not ell2 noise
construction.joint_characteristics: Retain self brackets,cross-state brackets and d<M_j^f,W_a>=sqrt(2kappa)*X_a f(Y_j)dt; W must be Brownian in the JOINT filtration
construction.weak_limit: Pass continuous drift/bracket readers and uniformly integrable martingale products,not stochastic-integral continuity; zero residual bracket recovers the same marked SDE in every paired limit
construction.diagonal: Pathwise uniqueness forces paired weak limits diagonal; bounded continuous distance tests give convergence in probability on the original common-noise space
construction.uniform_mean: For every fixed T and p>=1,sup_x E d_T(F_j(x,W),F(x,W))^p->0; x->F(x,W) is uniformly continuous in the Lp metric
construction.native_states: Weak native nu_j/rho_j convergence permits exact-marginal Skorokhod initial couplings,then product with W; no canonical coupling,global density ratio or Hilbert isometry claimed
construction.attached_readers: Bounded continuous joint path/noise/initial readers and uniformly recovering fixed-horizon likelihood/continuous occupation readers transport in their declared laws
construction.closed_obstruction_retained: Nonconstant-probe infinite-horizon density extension stays closed
